reason: I already pay for an IELTS course, so I'd take the free 3 fragments a day and maybe the 7-day trial, then cancel before it charges. $4.99 a month on top of my course feels like one subscription too many.
objection: It only checks pronunciation, not vocabulary or grammar, and my course already covers speaking, so I don't see why I should pay twice.
would_change_my_mind: A big one-time discount on the yearly plan, like $15 for the year, or a launch promo I could grab before my exam.
